name: fa_frontal_theta_alpha_v1
description: Fallback spec: frontal (AF7/AF8) theta and alpha log bandpower relative to beta, 2-s window. Same file format as fa_on_task_score.json. Use when the temporal electrodes are unusable or to compare against the data-driven spec.

preprocessing.group_aggregation: mean PSD across the group's channels, then features

score.formula: score = sum_i weight_i * sign_i * z_i over available features, normalised by sum |weight_i|; z against the wearer's calibration; positive = more on-task.
